headline: Khulshi police chief withdrawn after assault on cricketer Nayeem
summary: The officer in charge was removed from his post following allegations that police beat the national cricketer with batons and pipes.
details: Bangladesh national cricketer Nayeem Hasan alleges he was physically assaulted and humiliated by police in Chattogram on Friday night.
Nayeem claims officers stopped his CNG autorickshaw at Lalkhan Bazar intersection, grabbed him by the throat, and verbally abused him.
The cricketer says he was beaten with batons and pipes before being taken to Khulshi Police Station, where the mistreatment continued.
He alleges that police did not stop the assault even after locals identified him as a national cricketer.
Following the incident, Khulshi Police chief Md Arifur Rahman has been withdrawn from his post and attached to police lines.
While Chattogram Metropolitan Police (CMP) officials described the move as a regular distribution of responsibilities, a three-member probe committee has been formed.
The incident came to light after senior Bangladesh Cricket Board officials contacted the police station to intervene.
Nayeem Hasan has demanded maximum punishment for all officers involved in the harassment.
caption:
A national cricketer was beaten with batons and pipes by police in Chattogram.

Bangladesh national cricketer Nayeem Hasan alleges he was physically assaulted and humiliated by police in Chattogram on Friday night.

Nayeem claims officers stopped his CNG autorickshaw at Lalkhan Bazar intersection, grabbed him by the throat, and verbally abused him.

The cricketer says he was beaten with batons and pipes before being taken to Khulshi Police Station, where the mistreatment continued.

He alleges that police did not stop the assault even after locals identified him as a national cricketer.

Following the incident, Khulshi Police chief Md Arifur Rahman has been withdrawn from his post and attached to police lines.

While Chattogram Metropolitan Police (CMP) officials described the move as a regular distribution of responsibilities, a three-member probe committee has been formed.

The incident came to light after senior Bangladesh Cricket Board officials contacted the police station to intervene.

Nayeem Hasan has demanded maximum punishment for all officers involved in the harassment.

Source: Prothom Alo, bdnews24.com

summary: The football giants prepare for a high-stakes match as Brazil strategizes against the 'dark horse' Morocco.
